tasks.claim: The repository has a tested Effect client for the Instapaper Full API.
acceptance: OAuth 1.0a requests include OAuth and form parameters in the HMAC-SHA1 signature.
Duplicate, truncation and readback policies fail closed.
rollback: Remove the package and restore the previous lockfile and workspace manifest.

maintenance.reviewTrigger: Instapaper Full API or Effect HTTP API changes
maintenance.retireWhen: Instapaper Full API support is removed

tasks.claim: A stateless authenticated MCP Worker exposes bounded read tools and one approval-only save tool.
acceptance: MCP inputs and outputs use explicit schemas.
Only the save tool can mutate Instapaper and its annotations disclose the write.
rollback: Disable the MCP route and restore the prior Worker version.

maintenance.reviewTrigger: MCP SDK, OAuth provider or tool contract changes
maintenance.retireWhen: The remote MCP service is removed

tasks.claim: Alchemy owns the staged Cloudflare Worker, OAuth KV namespace and production Google Access login method without exposing clear secrets in source, command output or evidence.
acceptance: Plan scope matches the approved stage and resource set.
Apply is followed by provider readback and a fresh Google-authenticated read-only Instapaper check.
The existing Access application and its exact-email policy are preserved and allow only the configured account owner.
The Google app is In production with live public home and privacy pages and no sensitive or restricted scopes.
rollback: Revoke access, restore the last verified Worker version and rotate affected secrets.

maintenance.reviewTrigger: Alchemy, Cloudflare bindings, Access policy or secret set changes
maintenance.retireWhen: The Cloudflare service is destroyed with approved evidence

tasks.claim: The private Codex plugin bundles the reading skill and connects hosted Work to the remote MCP.
acceptance: The full skill and required source notes are inside the plugin.
The plugin states the hosted-browser limits and never implies local Chrome access.
rollback: Uninstall or disable the plugin and revoke its MCP OAuth grant.

maintenance.reviewTrigger: Skill, plugin format or hosted Work capability changes
maintenance.retireWhen: The hosted reading workflow is removed
